The LA Fires and what a disaster says about our physical and informational environments, by @Jon_Allsop. cjr.org/the_media_today/la_w…




— https://nitter.net/CJR/status/1878829345621659711#m

Matt Pearce 🦅🇺🇸 (@mattdpearce)

TAX ZUCKERBERG, FUND KICK-ASS LOCAL JOURNALISTS 

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/c…



— https://nitter.net/mattdpearce/status/1878607938547585212#m

TAX ZUCKERBERG, FUND KICK-ASS LOCAL JOURNALISTS 

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/c…
Thank you brother Brian!
This probably will not have any unpredictable long-term effects on our society.

Worth your time. Side note: I think Walter Lippmann was better as a critic than a theorist. He’s credited with inventing the idea of journalistic objectivity, a term that 1) he didn’t use 2) he didn’t define and 3) works better as a method of criticism than a quantifiable practice.
it’s really like three books’ worth of book, nuts

hmm instead of engaging with WaPo trollbait, please engage with my blog. no diapers mentioned

[Louder than it looks like I would physically be able to speak] Nah, I can talk. I'm just on the bus.

Favorite thing I’ve read so far this year: Janet Malcolm’s “In The Freud Archives”

Favorite things I read in 2025: Elena Ferrante’s “My Brilliant Friend” and Marguerite Yourcenar’s “Memoirs of Hadrian”
No matter how well-known Arkady Martine's "A Memory Called Empire" is, it deserves more.
Saw an AI bro refer to "brain-only writers" lol
(Turns out a tobacco settlement is a fixed cost that affects neither demand elasticity nor marginal cost, so you should just keep selling cheap cigs to maximize revenue)

I bought a managerial economics textbook for some self-guided learning, it’s been a handy guide to “here’s why everything feels like ass.” 

quiz question on how to precisely maximize profits after your cigarette company has a tobacco settlement
half the stuff I read about political media these days is like “hey man, if you’re not at the fart factory with the Fart King no one’s gonna smell your farts”
Fighting over Bluesky and X is so funny. It's like two rival opera companies screaming at each other.  Persuasion is done via short form video now, we're both retirement homes for uggos.
yes! bsky.app/profile/will...
